datafield.subfield: A tool-post grinder can be used for operations such as external and internal cylindrical grinding. This video program will show you how to set up and use the tool-post grinder on the lathe.
When a small number of helical or coil form springs are needed for repair work, it is common practice to wind them on the lathe. This video program will show you how springs can be made on the lathe.

Parting, or cutting-off, is the process of cutting a groove around a revolving workpiece to sever it from the piece held in the lathe. This video program will demonstrate the proper procedures for parting or cutting-off on the engine lathe.

Whether the actual cutting power is provided by hand or by the revolving spindle, the lathe is a very useful machine. This video program demonstrates the procedures for tapping internal threads and die cutting external threads on the engine lathe.
